headline: Operations Committee sent financial and cafeteria reports to full Board; reviewed $150,000 transfer for high school studies and $20,000 transfer for FOI legal fees.
summary: The committee reviewed the 2025-2026 final financial results, which showed a surplus of $564,808.06, and discussed moving $150,000 from Unallocated funds to cover high school study costs. It also reviewed cafeteria financial reports showing an ending balance of $-117,753, and heard that several maintenance projects are completed. The committee agreed to send the Financial Reports and Cafeteria Reports to the full Board for approval.
decisions: Sent the Financial Reports (4.1.1 - 4.1.5) to the full Board for approval.
Sent the Cafeteria Reports (4.2) to the full Board for approval.

decision_evidence.quote: The consensus of the Operations Committee was to send the Financial Reports (4.1.1 - 4.1.5) to the full Board for approval.
The consensus of the Operations Committee was to send the Cafeteria Reports (4.2) to the full Board for approval.
